title: Introducing Spyglass: Now Generally Available
summary: We're thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making our powerful tool available to everyone for enhanced insights and productivity.

title: Enhanced File Management in Your Editor
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the display of all your essential files directly within the editor for a more streamlined and visually appealing content creation experience.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Our new product roadmap provides a transparent view of our recent achievements, upcoming features, and exciting future plans.

title: Elevated Checkbox Experience
summary: Get more done with our enhanced checkboxes, now boasting a modern look, easier clicking, and effortless drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Enhanced Team Collaboration
summary: We've upgraded your collaboration experience, making it easier than ever to work seamlessly with your team.

title: Effortless Collaboration & Discovery
summary: Effortlessly find and explore all shared ideas and quests, enhancing your collaborative experience and ensuring you never miss valuable content.

title: Unlocking Global Communication
summary: We're thrilled to introduce comprehensive international language support, enabling Noeko to connect with a diverse global audience like never before.

title: Empowering Users: Noeko is Now Open Source
summary: We are thrilled to open Noeko's codebase to the community, empowering you with greater control and enabling direct collaboration in shaping its future.

title: Dynamic Knowledge Explorer
summary: Transform your knowledge graph into a dynamic workflow hub, allowing you to quickly filter and explore your information with unprecedented precision.

title: Precision Search and Personalized Knowledge Views
summary: Effortlessly find and organize specific information using advanced filtering, sorting, and the ability to save your customized search results as personalized collections.

title: Smarter Note Organization
summary: This feature will allow users to better organize their notes by providing new, interactive ways to display and engage with linked content directly within their current view.

title: Elevate Your Workspace with Stunning New Themes
summary: Get ready for a visual overhaul as we refine existing themes and introduce a vibrant collection of new styles to personalize your workspace.

title: More Accurate Time-Based Greetings

title: Unlock More Content Types
